era: TripAdvisor desktop 2019 (Arquivo.pt captures of the US home page Mar, Jul and Nov 2019, hotel review pages May, Sep and Oct 2019, and a Dec 2019 search page): white header with the owl logo, Hotels / Things to do / Restaurants / Flights / Vacation Rentals / Cruises / More links, Post / Trips / Inbox / Log in or JOIN, the big 'Where to?' search on the home page, Arial type and #00a680 green buttons; hotel pages with rating, review count, 'Visit hotel website', price deals, 'View all photos', 'Write a review', 'All reviews' with filters, 'Search reviews', 'Read more' and Helpful votes, Room tips, nearby hotels and restaurants on a map; footer with About Us / Press / Careers / Investor Relations / Content Integrity, Owners / Business Advantage / Sponsored Placements / Advertise with Us / Become an Affiliate, Write a review / Join / Travelers' Choice / Blog, iPhone and Android app links, CURRENCY/REGION, Facebook / Twitter / Pinterest / Instagram and the TheFork / Viator / Cruise Critic sites. The live site blocks headless browsers, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's Chrome with the inventory collector.
